title.en: A V0 imported recipe is refused on a robot and assigned to a person when one is present

goal.en: The fifi.cooking collection holds 2,257 described recipes (V0, RFC-0009). Every step is a legacy step that no device can execute. The dry run refuses them on any robot alone and hands every step to a person when one is present.

note.en: A V0 document passes the recipe schema: described is a valid level.
Fattoush salad (archive, CC-BY-4.0) on the kitchen robot, nobody present: refused at the first step.

expect.refusal.detail: device cannot perform cw.op.legacy_step and no person is present to do it

note.en: With a person present: accepted, and all three steps are the person's.
The vocabulary entry says why: legacy_step belongs to the legacy family, declares no sensors, and its definition says no device declares it as a capability.

outcome.en: You know that a described recipe is findable and attributable today, and that no device will act on it until a reviewed process graph makes it V1. Next: scenario 016 reads a V1 recipe as a document.
